text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-7831 fired for service= inference-gateway — 5xx error rate > 4% (5m) in region=us-west-2. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Paging: oncall-sre. Link: https://pd.example/INC-7831

incident-bot: Symptoms detected: increased 502/503 counts, spike at 2026-03-17T10:20Z, correlated with recent deploy (deploy-2026-03-17T10:18Z). Runbook: inference > error-spike.

sophie_sre: acked. I'm oncall. starting triage — checking recent deploy and host metrics. will update every 5m. :headphones:

opsbot: INC-7831 acknowledged by sophie_sre at 2026-03-17T10:21:10Z

raj_runtime: I see a tail of 502s from the kv-proxy layer and a rise in conn reset stats on the us-west-2 edge. quick log snippet from gateway:
```
2026-03-17T10:19:34Z ERROR gateway handler failed request id=abc123 status=502 backend_err="upstream read timeout"
2026-03-17T10:19:35Z ERROR gateway handler failed request id=def456 status=503 backend_err="kv cache miss + timeout"
```

maria_oncall: Confirmed customer-facing errors — Support dashboard shows ~30 customer requests failing in the last 10m, most are short requests (<=256 tokens). Ticket queue increasing.

sophie_sre: good context. can we isolate whether this is router/caching or model serving? raj, can you hit a model pod directly?

raj_runtime: hitting model pods directly (10.0.12.*) returns 200 for `/health` but token generation endpoints show high latency and intermittent 5xx. sample curl: `curl -s -D - -X POST http://10.0.12.15:8080/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> 502 sometimes, 200 other times.

leo_support: customers on chat reporting increased error rates; two paying customers reported timeouts ~10:21. sharing customer IDs in PD exec channel.

tina_product: any config changes to routing/batching in the last deploy? I remember we flipped a new batching heuristic last rollout.

raj_runtime: yes — deploy-2026-03-17 enabled dynamic-batching-v2 in runtime flags. rolling that flag back on one canary host to validate.

sophie_sre: do rollback of batching flag across the fleet if canary confirms. Meanwhile thin out traffic to model pool alpha and route to beta (older runtime) as fallback.

raj_runtime: kicked off rollback on canary. command: `kubectl patch deploy runtime --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"runtime/flags":"dynamic-batching-v1"}}}}}' -n inference`

maria_oncall: started traffic diversion: routing weight changed — alpha 40% -> 0% over 30s, beta increased. Note: small blip expected during shift.

opsbot: Traffic shift executed: alpha->beta weight change complete.

sophie_sre: checking metrics — 5xx rate dropping in us-west-2 from 4.2% -> 1.1% over last 2m. CPU on model pods dropping too.

raj_runtime: canary rollback looks good: canary pod traces show decreased queue depth and KV cache hit rates stable. proceeding with fleet rollback now.

tina_product: thanks. I'm posting a short customer status note (incidents.redwood.com/INC-7831) to keep folks updated. Will link to status page when ready.

leo_support: queue stabilized. pausing new escalation emails to customer success. leaving monitoring watch.

sophie_sre: mitigation successful for now. next steps: 1) finish rollback, 2) bake metrics for 30m, 3) root cause postmortem if rollback confirmed cause. tagging eng-runtime + infra. :white_check_mark:

maria_oncall: rollback finished at 2026-03-17T10:29Z. 5xx rate now ~0.3% and trending down. closing PD alert once we hit stable window.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-7831 status: RESOLVED by sophie_sre at 2026-03-17T10:32:34Z — mitigation: rollback dynamic-batching-v1 flag and traffic diversion to beta runtime.

sophie_sre: leaving a short runbook note: "If 5xx spike after dynamic-batching rollouts, rollback flag + divert traffic to previous runtime; monitor KV cache miss rates and queue depth." I'll open a postmortem ticket and assign to raj_runtime + infra team.

raj_runtime: will collect traces and perf diffs. suspect batching heuristic introduced a pathological batching window for short requests, causing backend timeouts.

tina_product: adding postmortem stakeholders: @raj_runtime, @sophie_sre, @maria_oncall, @leo_support, @kyle_infra. ETA draft: EOD.

leo_support: marking customers contacted for affected requests. will attach request ids in the postmortem.

sophie_sre: thanks everyone. I'll leave the channel open for 30m for any regressions. :eyes:

maria_oncall: 30m watch started. no further action unless we see new spikes.
